title: Refreshed Templates
description: Changes the armour trim crafting recipes to reduce the cost.
body:
![Aqua Blue Blocky Words Reading "Refreshed Templates"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50c282f2587c3f3fae5c9bd787fc799964b9f129.png)

# What Is Refreshed Templates
Refreshed Templates is a Datapack that makes armour trim template recipes cheaper by making the recipes use one diamond and seven of another item e.g. coast uses one diamond and seven cobblestone.
